items.title: George Guesnon Interview
items.q: You were telling us about the band of the Alamo, who else was in there? ... Oh yeah, the trombone player was Yank Johnson.

ctx.x: You were telling us about the band of the Alamo, who else was in there? Had the trombone player?

Oh yeah, the trombone player was Yank Johnson. Oh, he was very good. I mean, I kept having his name confused. I used to call him Yank Robinson all the time until I found out that he was Yank Johnson. Now here was a guy who played one of the sweetest trombones.
